New message in #sales:

mike: what's the latest status on the Umbrella deal?

input.text: Hey Mike — I don't have access to the CRM or any deal-tracking data here, so I can't pull up the current status on the Umbrella deal. Could you check it in the CRM directly, or let me know where that info lives and I can try to help from there?

content.text: I replied to Mike honestly — I don't have any deal-tracking or CRM tools available in this environment, so I can't look up the Umbrella deal status. Rather than guess or fabricate, I pointed him to the CRM and offered to help if he can point me to where the info lives.
